title: Shear force, from the ground up

scenes.narration: Let us go through shear force. What it is, how you read it off a beam, and the one check to do before you draw anything.

visual.text: Shear force, from the ground up

scenes.narration: Shear force at any section is the sum of the vertical forces to the left of that section. An upward force to the left counts as positive.
Before any of that, check the reactions balance. Sum of vertical forces zero, sum of moments zero. On a six metre span with twelve kilonewtons at midspan, each reaction is six.
The one thing to keep: the reactions must balance before you draw anything at all.
